scope: Economic falsification of the already-frozen price-independent one-ticket 3renhuku rule only. This is not the live odds-gated V2 policy.
stake_policy: flat 100 yen per pre-frozen selected race; no Kelly, no martingale, no stake escalation
return_rule: If frozen 3renhuku ticket equals official winning 3renhuku combination, return official payout per 100 yen; otherwise return 0.
primary_metrics: ticket hit count and hit rate
total stake, total return, net yen and ROI
largest single return as share of total return
ROI after removing the single largest winning return
low_power_rule: If fewer than 30 selected bets remain after process quarantine/fail-closed exclusions, label economic result LOW_POWER regardless of ROI sign.
jackpot_rule: A positive ROI with >50% of total return from one hit is labeled CONCENTRATED and cannot support a profitability claim.
interpretation: No historical closing-odds filter is applied; selection was frozen before payout access.
This evaluates whether the structural rule itself has favorable realized settlement under flat 100 yen, not whether the current live odds gate is calibrated.
Positive ROI alone does not prove future profitability; negative ROI falsifies this exact price-independent strategy on this sample.
No rule rescue or threshold adjustment on positions 2001..5000 after payout access.
